3.insights: Demand is very elastic. A constant-elasticity fit between the two points gives elasticity of about -11.5, which would put the optimum near cost, around 1.1. That is probably an extrapolation, since demand is likely not constant-elasticity. A linear fit gives q ≈ 4.62 - 8.5*(p-2.75), so q reaches 0 near p=3.3. Profit (p-1)*q under that fit peaks around 2.15 to 2.2. The optimum is likely below 2.75, roughly in the 1.8 to 2.4 range. The competitor price tracks ours at about +0.15 to +0.2, so it may be correlated with our price and not an independent factor.
